gameDescriptionHtml:
Shambles is a combination of text RPG, deckbuilding and roguelike. Play as an explorer in a bunker, expedite vast world and encounter countless stories. Choose what to do in any given situation to complete missions.

When you encounters combat, turn-based card deck battle begins. Engage in strategic combat by using skills and cards to attack and defend against enemies.

Story completes in a zone, you can select next zone on the map to explore. Explore this large world by moving to zone adjacent to your current location. There are hidden zones and dungeons somewhere on the continent, you’ll have opportunity to refine your character in the middle of expedition. You can enhance character’s stats, buy and equip gear, unlock skills as well for next battles.

There are card and equipment can only be obtained by completing certain stories. Explore the chaotic world finding hidden elements.

Game Features

  • Multiple endings – As an explorer, you can travel the world of Shambles and uncover its secrets, find yourself at the center of a great war, or die futilely without trace. The fate of this world and your expedition depends only on your choices.
  • Deckbuilding card battle – Build your own deck and utilize it to face your enemies. You can be a soldier dealing modern weapons, a knight on the battlefield, or a powerful wizard. Combine hundreds of cards, equipment and skills to create your own tactics.
  • A wide variety of cards, skills and equipment – Over 300 cards, 200+ skills and equipment can be combined to create completely different play styles. Try different strategies on every single expeditions.
  • A vast continent – This new world is now called continent of Eustea. The continent has over 100 zones for you to explore and with that comes many stories to tell. For 500 years, humans have survived in different ways, achieving new civilizations are completely different from the old ones. Explore this uncharted world and find traces of forgotten civilizations.
  • Record of a new world – The world outside is very different from the world you know. As a stranger from the bunker to this world, you want to leave record of it. Create a pictorial book about this unknown world including new creatures, people you’ve met, books and journals you’ve collected.
  • Many forks in the road – As you progress the story, you’ll face crossroads needs choices. These choices can be small forks in the road or huge forks completely change your play style. Zones you explore, character’s health, equipment and stats can all be forks in the road.
